summary: Frontend-only mobile regression run completed for new FreeCAD-style workflow. Core flows work (intro/tree shown, all feature types add, property edits apply, 3D routing works, viewer controls work, legacy manual+panel conversion still reaches 3D). Found one critical mobile usability issue in property sheet close interaction.

ui_bugs.issue: On 375x667 mobile viewport, close button becomes outside viewport/unreachable after opening from feature-tree add action; normal tap fails and blocks next actions unless workaround is used.

issues: Property bottom sheet presentation is not reliably usable at mobile-first viewport (375x667).

action_items: Fix FeaturePropertySheet mobile layout so close control is always within viewport and tappable (375x667 baseline).
Re-test full add-feature sequence without JS click workaround.
Confirm property-sheet open/close usability after adding Pad/Base Wall/Flange/Hem in sequence.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/app/canvas.tsx is very large (~1270 LOC), exceeding maintainability guideline; split into focused modules/components.
FeaturePropertySheet lacks keyboard/safe-area handling, likely contributing to bottom-sheet usability issues on small mobile viewport.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Repro path: auth-guest -> home-new-blueprint -> tap freecad-add-pad-button. Property sheet opens but close control can be outside viewport for 375x667. Prior run needed JS-dispatched click to close and continue with remaining feature tests.
rca_of_issue: RCA: FeaturePropertySheet modal is presented from canvas flow but mobile web layout can place actionable header control outside visible/tappable region at 375x667. Repro: open canvas, add feature from tree, attempt normal click on freecad-close-properties-button => Playwright reports element outside viewport. Mitigation: enforce bottom-sheet height/position constraints with safe-area-aware container and verify close control remains in visible hit area across small viewports.
